entries.zh: 吐口水；把口水吐得远远的（唾弃）
entries.en: to spit saliva far away; to spit out (saliva)
to spit phlegm; to expectorate (flemas, gargajos)

entries.zh: 文过；掩饰过错、推卸过失
entries.en: to gloss over one's fault; to cover up a fault
entries.notes: H 栏仅存『文』一字、R 栏空，释义依『escusar la culpa』系列与『文过』成语推断。

entries.en: to shirk the blame; to put off a fault
to excuse oneself on a pretext; to decline with an excuse
to ward off or dodge a blow
entries.notes: 『抵』本义为抵挡，此处义近『闪避』，系按 L 栏『huir el golpe』定夺。

entries.en: to decline; to refuse (not wish to)
to whitewash, gloss over a fault
to make excuses; to decline on a pretext

entries.zh: 假贤（假𠢕）；装贤能、假意谦让以推托
entries.en: to feign worthiness; to decline with pretended modesty (a feigned sage)
entries.notes: L 栏『noquer』[疑]，M 栏附『sabio fingido』为释，与『escusarse』的衔接属推断。

entries.en: to spare or exempt a part; to economize a portion
entries.notes: 『敛省』为罕见组合且 R 栏空，义依『省』与 L 栏『escusar parte』定。

entries.zh: 省却世事；避开官司与争吵
entries.en: to keep clear of worldly affairs; to avoid lawsuits and quarrels
entries.notes: [疑] pleyson/pleytos，M 栏混入西语 pleytos、ruisos 作释。

entries.en: to pass the buck; to shift the blame to one another

entries.zh: 省事；避免麻烦、避开诉讼
entries.en: to avoid trouble; to keep clear of lawsuits
to lay the blame on someone else

entries.zh: 推给这个、推给那个；对众人推托
entries.en: to put off everyone, passing the buck this way and that
entries.notes: 『只』『许』作『此』『彼』解属古文用法，释义据此推断。

entries.en: to push away; to decline, be unwilling
to decline; to refuse politely
to plead a pretext (some mishap) in excuse
entries.notes: L 栏『sur in』[疑] 残损，释义依 H 栏『托事故』。

entries.en: to fabricate an excuse; to make up a story to decline
